dictionary.title: Dictionaries
dictionary.description: Import a Yomitan (.zip) or StarDict dictionary. For StarDict, pick the .ifo, .idx and .dict files together, or a .zip / .tar.gz containing them.
dictionary.noneInstalled: No dictionaries installed. Add one in Settings → Dictionaries.
dictionary.noTextApp: No installed app accepts text to look up. Google Translate, DeepL or a dictionary app such as GoldenDict will add themselves here.
